```plato

// A fully attributed point cloud, as produced by LiDAR
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lidar) and photogrammetry. All channels are
// parallel to Positions; an empty channel array means the channel is absent.
// Intensities are unitless sensor return strengths.
type AttributedPointCloud3D
    implements IValue, IPointCloud3D, IDeformable3D
{
    Positions: Array<Point3D>;
    Normals: Array<Direction3D>;
    Colors: Array<Color>;
    Intensities: Array<Number>;
}
```
